analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the HR history, the member register and the payroll lines, reads the plan rules and the amendment correctly, and carries the income protection cover's cancellations by month of service, the group's one record of hires leaving a default, as the plan's opt-outs files TNK 14.5 million (14.0 million if it reads the opt-in join curve as the share who have chosen, 8.5 million if the 43 per cent who join contribute from the first payroll and nobody else does), when the hires who have not yet made a choice at 3 per cent plus the joiners at their own rates files TNK 11.5 million.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a choice model of a default: each hire carries a preference and a moment of active choice, and until that moment the default holds, so the forward default's take-up is the inactive share plus the active share who prefer to stay, the way behavioural models of defaults and procrastination separate preference from inertia; with clinical or school nouns there is no default to sit in and no moment of choice to wait for.

driver: When a default switches direction, the record from the old default shows only the units whose preference differs from it and only once they have acted, so the pace at which every unit acts is that record's take-up curve divided by its own plateau; under the new default every unit holds the default until it acts, and the forward take-up is the not-yet-acted share plus the acted share who prefer it, not the old take-up, not one minus it, and not the old curve read as the pace of acting.
driver_concrete: Vindeholm's opt-in record shows 43 per cent of hires joining within five years at a pace where 35 per cent of hires have made a choice by their first payroll and 90 per cent by their twelfth; from January 2027 every hire contributes 3 per cent until choosing, so the intake's FY2027 match is the not-yet-chosen at 3 per cent plus the joiners at their own rates, TNK 11.5 million, not the cover's 16 per cent cancellation curve carried as the plan's opt-outs (14.5 million) and not the 43 per cent contributing from the first payroll (8.5 million).
stump: A competent analyst carries the income protection cover's cancellations, the group's one record of hires leaving a default, as the share of the 2027 intake that will opt out and files TNK 14.5 million against 11.5 million; the step that lands it there is reading a cancellation curve set by the 16 per cent of hires who want to drop a 0.4 per cent cover as the opt-outs of a plan 57 per cent of hires never join, when the opt-in record holds both what hires prefer and how fast every hire makes a choice.

differentiation.task136: there a scheduled intervention mostly enrols units about to take up the outcome on their own; here the default itself holds every unit until it acts, and the act's pace must be recovered from a record where only one preference is visible
differentiation.task170: v3 carried a trial's efficacy through the share of exposure that reaches the protected state; here nothing is transported between settings: one population's own record under one default is read for two things it holds at once, a preference and a moment of choice, and the forward default is rebuilt from them
differentiation.task161: there a stock built ahead of a cost step drains at the steady share of use every earlier build drained at; here no stock drains: each hire holds a default until a moment of choice, and the choice's pace has to be recovered from a record that shows only one of the two preferences
differentiation.task259: there a level at a reference date is carried from earlier reports by how it moves at a fixed grade; here nothing is carried between dates, the forward take-up is rebuilt from a preference share and a timing curve read in the same record under the opposite default
differentiation.task87: there a schedule's exclusivity caps a delivered count; here no capacity or exclusivity binds, the gap is when each hire makes an active choice and what it chooses
differentiation.task105: there a new outlet wins only the part of its catchment nearer to it than to a sister; here there is no spatial competition, the forward default reverses who must act
differentiation.task229: there a convex conversion of a daily mean is biased by within-day swings; here there is no conversion or within-period swing, the selected view of a choice record is undone by dividing the join curve by its own plateau

lineage.driver: Units move to another line at the first of their scheduled measurements that reads at or above a fixed level, and a single measurement scatters around each unit's own path by more than the path rises between measurements, so most moves come months before the paths reach the level; only the chance that each scheduled measurement reads over the level, taken from each unit's own path and the record's scatter, forecasts them, while paths projected to the level, a fixed age, the recent count of moves, the moves seen at each recorded level or a pooled rate each misplace them.
lineage.driver_concrete: Children on paediatric antiretroviral regimens move to adult TLD at the first clinic weighing that reads 30 kg or more, and a clinic weighing scatters more than a kilogram either side of a child's own growth line while the line rises about a fifth of a kilogram a month, so most switches come months before the line reaches 30 kg; the children's line of the C7 order needs each child's chance of a qualifying weighing at each visit its own dispensing interval schedules, and projecting growth to 30 kg, a switch age, the recent switch count or the switch rate by last recorded weight each misplace the line by a pallet or more, the register's own rates because its switches came under the 35 kg band and at the monthly visits the 2026 guidelines replaced.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits each child's growth line from the register, switches the child to TLD at the first scheduled visit after the line reaches 30 kg and files line 2 at 10 pallets against 11, because the first weighing that reads 30 kg comes months before the line gets there.
lineage.analyst_test: With every field read, the 2026 dosing band applied as filed and the SOP's line 2 built as filed, a strong analyst projects each child's weighings forward on a fitted growth line, moves the child to TLD when the line reaches 30 kg and files line 2 at 10 pallets of 8,064 bottles, one pallet below the 11 the scheduled weighings imply.
lineage.domain_test: The line turns on the paediatric regimen-transition forecast of ARV quantification, the patient-months on TLD of children who will be weighed into the 30 kg band at their scheduled visits, built from each child's weighings, the clinics' weighing scatter, each child's dispensing interval and retention; with another field's nouns the dosing band applied at a clinic weighing, the dispensing interval and the cycle order's paediatric line stop meaning anything.

lineage.niche: an implementing non-profit's forecast, for its donor, of how many Ombeni fever cases the March 2027 county-wide distribution of repellent sleeping nets in Ruvari County will avert among the people sleeping under them from April to December 2027, when the county's vector bites earlier in the evening and more outdoors than at any site of the five-site trial that measured the nets' protective efficacy
lineage.driver: A protection acts only on the exposure that arrives while the protected state holds, so an efficacy measured in a trial is a per-exposure protection times the share of its own sites' exposure that arrived in that state; the target's share is the overlap of when and where exposure arrives with when people are in the protected state, read hour by hour from two records at a finer grain than the trial's headline, and carrying the trial's efficacy, or multiplying it by the target's share without dividing out the sites' own, misstates the forward effect.
lineage.driver_concrete: Ruvari County's Ombeni fever vector bites from dusk and half of it outdoors, so only 0.36 of a resident's bites arrive while in bed under a net, against 0.49 to 0.96 at the KINGA-5 sites; the nets' pooled protective efficacy of 56.7 per cent is a per-bite protection of 0.80 times each site's in-bed share, so the cases averted among users from April to December 2027 are the plan's baseline times the planned use times 0.80 times 0.36, not the trial's efficacy and not that efficacy times the county's share.
lineage.stump: A competent solver applies the trial's pooled protective efficacy of 56.7 per cent to the plan's expected cases among net users and files 22,000 cases averted against 11,000; the step that lands it there is carrying an efficacy measured where most bites arrived after participants were in bed to a county whose vector bites early and half outdoors, where 0.36 of a resident's bites arrive in bed against 0.49 to 0.96 at the sites.
lineage.answer: About 11,000 Ombeni fever cases averted among the people sleeping under the March 2027 LulaNet R nets in Ruvari County from April to December 2027, 21 per cent of the 53,042 cases the county expects (11,208 unrounded from the shipped files).
